title: Sony Music, Warner sue Anthropic, alleging a “brazen campaign” of intellectual property theft
content_snippet: This latest lawsuit is particularly broad and homes in on accusations of illegal piracy.
title_zh: 索尼音乐与华纳起诉Anthropic，指控其“公然盗用”知识产权
summary_zh: 索尼音乐和华纳查普尔音乐公司联合起诉AI公司Anthropic，指控其大规模非法使用受版权保护的音乐作品训练模型，要求每件作品最高15万美元的赔偿。
key_points: 两大唱片公司指控Anthropic大规模盗版其音乐作品用于AI训练
诉讼要求每件侵权作品赔偿15万美元，并额外索赔每例2.5万美元
该诉讼聚焦于非法盗版行为，范围广泛且严厉

title: Sony Music and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic
content_snippet: Sony Music and Warner Chappell have filed suit against Anthropic in the US District Court for the Northern District of California seeking damages for "tens of thousands" copyrighted works. The companies are asking for up to $150,000 per work, plus up to $25,000 for each instance when identifiable copyright data was stripped. In total, the […]
title_zh: 索尼音乐与华纳查普尔联合起诉Anthropic侵犯版权
summary_zh: 索尼音乐与华纳查普尔在加州联邦法院对Anthropic提起诉讼，指控其侵犯数万首歌曲的版权，寻求高达每件作品15万美元的法定赔偿金。
key_points: 诉讼在加州北区联邦法院提起，涉及数万件受版权保护作品
原告要求每件作品最高15万美元的法定赔偿金
指控Anthropic未经授权使用作品进行AI模型训练

title: “We’re not doing 30 bets a year”: Vijay Pande on betting small after running $4 billion at a16z
content_snippet: Vijay Pande — who left a16z's roughly $4 billion biotech practice last year to start the much smaller, AI-native VZVC — talks about why biology is finally shifting from a "discovery" science to an "engineering" one, why clinical trials are still brutally expensive, and why he thinks open, shared datasets (not walled-off ones) are what will actually let AI transform medicine.
title_zh: Vijay Pande谈离开a16z后的小规模投资策略：一年不做30个赌注
summary_zh: Vijay Pande在离开a16z旗下约40亿美元的生物技术实践后，创立了小型AI原生风投公司VZVC。他阐述了生物学正从发现科学转变为工程科学，以及为何临床试验成本依然高昂。
key_points: Vijay Pande离开a16z后创办小型AI风投VZVC，转向小规模投资
他认为生物学正从发现科学转变为工程科学
探讨了临床试验成本依然高昂及开放共享数据的重要性
